stories.headline: EEAST reports its busiest year ever for 999 calls
stories.body: East of England Ambulance Service took nearly 100,000 calls in September and attended over 84,000 incidents. Crews lost more than 18,000 hours to hospital handover waits, and there have been over 1.2 million calls since September 2025.
stories.why: Every hour lost at a hospital door is a crew not free for the next 999 call.

stories.headline: Physicians warn corridor care needs whole-system fix
stories.body: The Royal College of Physicians welcomed the £140m urgent care boost but warned that around 2,400 corridor care cases happen in England’s emergency departments every day, with 92,177 in August.
stories.why: Crowded EDs mean longer handovers, so crews are held at hospital while calls wait in the community.

stories.headline: Five-year review of cardiac arrests in Northern Ireland
stories.body: NIAS and Queen’s University reviewed 14,255 out-of-hospital cardiac arrests from 2018 to 2022. Bystander CPR rose from 70% to 79%, but only 5% of patients were shocked with a public defib before the ambulance arrived.
stories.why: Bystander CPR is rising, but public defibs are still rarely used before crews get there.

stories.headline: NEAS staff trial an AI note-taking tool
stories.body: 38 North East Ambulance Service staff are testing a tool on their iPads that records and summarises patient conversations, in an eight-week trial. A clinician checks every note before it is added to the record, and the trust will decide next steps in November.
stories.why: Less time typing could mean more time with patients, but the clinician still owns the record.

stories.headline: NQP award honours paramedic who lifts colleagues
stories.body: SECAmb paramedic Matty Baker has won the Alice Clark Award, given in memory of a 21-year-old NQP who died in service in 2022. It recognises growth from newly qualified to experienced practitioner, and Matty was praised for his kindness and humour.
stories.why: The NQP years are about growth, and looking after each other on tough shifts matters.
